settings.heading: Q2: How does Venustas heated apparel change your lifestyle?
settings.body: J:  I have Raynaud’s syndrome and it is therefore difficult and all the more important to keep me warm. To be able to enjoy the winter and be comfortable, I must be well dressed and equipped. Venusta’s sleeveless jacket helps me keep me warm, in several contexts.

settings.heading: Q3: Which part most appealing to you about Venustas?
settings.body: J: I like the fact that they are versatile, neutral clothes that can keep us warm for all occasions.

settings.heading: Q4: How do you feel about Venustas heated apparel?
settings.body: J:  : I like my jacket because I can wear it during my sports outings, as well as to go to work during the extreme cold of winter. My jacket really helps me keep my heat and therefore makes all the difference.

settings.heading: Q5: The reason to be our V+ Master.
settings.body: J: Just because I am an active person, who likes to try new things and get out of comfort zone. Everything you need to enjoy your clothes.
